description: This file defines utility functions for allocating IPv4 addresses within a subnet, either deterministically based on subscriber ID or by accepting a requested IP. It provides methods for IP address calculation that are used in a network management context.

methods.name: str deterministic_ip(subnet_cidr: str, subscriber_id: str)
methods.description: Calculates a deterministic IPv4 address within a subnet for a given subscriber ID by hashing the ID and mapping it to an available address.

methods.name: str allocate_ip(subnet_cidr: str, subscriber_id: str, requested_ip: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Allocates an IP address for a subscriber, either returning a requested IP if provided or calculating a deterministic IP based on subscriber ID.

ctags.name: allocate_ip
ctags.pattern: /^def allocate_ip(subnet_cidr: str, subscriber_id: str, requested_ip: Optional[str] = None) -> str/
ctags.signature: (subnet_cidr: str, subscriber_id: str, requested_ip: Optional[str] = None)
